rows.label: Dorma Model
rows.note: on her own prebuilt Hound, or as her random component blueprint
rows.alt: trade for the blueprint from another player if RNG stalls

conditions: Vanquish, never convert: a converted Sister hands over no Hound and no component blueprint.
Roughly 1 in 3 Sisters carry a Dorma-headed Hound if the three Models are weighted equally (unconfirmed); a handful of Sisters is typical.
The Hound a vanquished Sister mails you arrives fully built but ungilded.
A Parazon Mercy on the downed Candidate is what creates the Sister in the first place.
The Treasurer despawns if you take too long, and its Zenith crown is consumed on every Granum Void entry.
bonuses: Each vanquish also hands over her Tenet weapon, whatever Model her Hound carries.
If her Hound isn't Dorma, the random component blueprint she drops is still tradeable toward a Dorma Model build.

disclosures.title: the fast Sister loop
disclosures.body: Solo, normal, not Steel Path, Capture on Hydra, Pluto. A squad raises the kill requirement inside the Granum Void, so run it alone. Waypoint a gold hand first, kill the capture target, then come back and insert the Zenith crown; if no hand has shown up halfway through the tile, restart, and a hand within roughly 200m of extraction can mean the Candidate never spawns. Inside the Void the spawn cap is about 20 enemies and nothing new arrives until that batch is dead, so stay on top of them with a chaining or nuking weapon. Equip the Xoris: heavy-attack the Granum ghosts to charge it, then detonate on the captured Solaris target for a large time extension, and kill Parvos units for the time triangles they drop. Kill the Treasurer every cycle for the next crown, and hit Replay on the white end screen to re-run instantly.

disclosures.title: you don't need to build one
disclosures.body: Near-unanimous: the prebuilt Hound a vanquished Sister mails you works exactly the same as one you hand-build, including for Mastery once gilded. Watch which Model each new Sister's Hound carries before committing to the fight, and you may never touch the blueprint route. If you do build from a dropped blueprint, the Dorma Model itself costs 50,000 credits, 5 Spectral Debris, 5 Gallium, 2 Radian Sentirum and 10 Mirewinder Parallel Biode over 24h, and still needs a Core, Bracket and Stabilizer, each its own Sister blueprint drop with its own Fortuna or Deimos resource list.
